visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with her hair in a messy bun is sitting on a grey sofa in a brightly lit modern living room. In the foreground, a person's foot is held up, being tickled or held by someone off-camera. (2) The camera pans to a large television screen displaying a romantic scene from a drama, where a man and a woman are looking deeply into each other's eyes, very close to kissing. (3) The woman on the sofa leans forward, watching the screen with intense anticipation, her facial expression shifting from concentration to excitement. (4) As the scene on the TV progresses without a kiss, the woman suddenly throws her head back and screams, then begins punching the sofa cushion and the air in an exaggerated display of frustration. (5) She stands up and continues to gesture wildly at the TV, then points a remote control at the screen while continuing to shout. (6) She eventually sits back down, breathless and laughing, looking directly at the camera with a wide smile. (7) She then notices the foot in the foreground again, makes a face of pure disgust, and pushes the foot away with her hands while speaking animatedly. (8) A grey cat walks briefly across the background floor as the woman continues her comedic interaction with the person off-camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A soft, romantic piano melody plays continuously in the background. A female voice speaks in a calm, expectant tone, repeatedly saying 'kiss him.' (2) The female voice erupts into an extremely loud, sustained high-pitched scream of excitement and frustration, accompanied by the dull thudding sounds of hands hitting a soft sofa. (3) The speaker transitions into high-arousal, rapid speech, shouting about episode numbers and a lack of on-screen romantic action, her voice reaching a high peak of intensity and strain. (4) The shouting concludes with audible, heavy sighing and is immediately followed by bright, rhythmic laughter. (5) The female voice returns to a conversational volume, complaining about a bad smell in an exaggeratedly disgusted tone, which is followed by a short, muffled male voice and further laughter while the piano music continues its loop.
